digest.component_or_area: import help documentation and CLI reference generation
propositions: Canonical import parser help must document current 256-event batching behavior for independent create, parent, file-impact, and verification passes.
Canonical import help must document deferred push behavior after successful import work and serial source_id skipping for resumption.
Generated packaged help, overview help, and CLI reference must be regenerated from canonical parser help with no runtime importer changes.
Guidance must explicitly state no whole-file atomicity, no automatic repair of partial tickets, and concurrent duplicate risk when scans race.
Help generator and import documentation tests must pass without changes to importer runtime behavior.
